item.title: President Lee: "After You Left, Countless 'Roh Moo-hyuns' Were Born Again… I Am One of Them" (이 대통령 “당신 떠난 뒤 다시 태어난 수많은 ‘노무현’…저도 그 중 하나”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 23rd, marking the 17th anniversary of former President Roh Moo-hyun's death, "I will carry on President Roh’s will, who transformed the line of division into a path of peace and achieved the October 4 Inter-Korean Joint Declaration, and walk unwaveringly toward peaceful coexistence and shared growth." (이재명 대통령이 23일 노무현 전 대통령 서거 17주기를 맞아 “분단의 선을 평화의 길로 바꾸며 10·4 남북공동선언을 이뤄내신 대통령님의 뜻을 이어받아, 평화공존과 공동성장의 길을 흔들림 없이 걸어가겠다”고 말했다.)

President Lee attended the memorial ceremony for the 17th anniversary of former President Roh's death held at Bongha Village in Gimhae, South Gyeongsang Province, on this day, and said, "After you left, countless 'Roh Moo-hyuns' were born again on this land. I too am one of them. Now, beyond a feeling of remembrance, I feel the immense responsibility and weight as President of the Republic of Korea and intend to carry on your will." (이 대통령은 이날 경남 김해 봉하마을에서 열린 노 전 대통령 서거 17주기 추도식에 참석해 “당신께서 떠나신 후 이 땅에는 수많은 ‘노무현’들이 다시 태어났다. 저 역시 그중 한 사람”이라며 “이제 저는 추모하는 마음을 넘어, 대한민국 대통령으로서 막중한 책임과 무게를 느끼며 당신의 뜻을 이어가려 한다”고 말했다.)

President Lee then added, "I will ensure that the Government of the People's Sovereignty completes the unfinished dream of President Roh. Without fearing the backlash from established interests, I will drive forward reforms that eliminate cheating and privileges. I will create a balanced, developed Republic of Korea where people in every corner of the nation, without any region being left behind, prosper evenly." (이 대통령은 그러면서 “대통령님의 못다 이룬 꿈, 국민주권정부가 반드시 완수하겠다”며 “기득권의 반발을 두려워하지 않고 반칙과 특권을 걷어내는 개혁을 추진하겠다. 어디 하나 소외되는 곳 없이 전국 방방곡곡의 국민이 고르게 잘사는 균형발전 대한민국을 만들겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

President Lee continued, "Just as you did, I will prioritize right and wrong over political advantage or disadvantage. I will choose conscience over compromise, and sincerity over calculation. Keeping in mind that the sole measure of a successful president is the improvement of the people's lives, I will devote all my abilities." President Lee also said, "I will surely protect this country and its people, whom you cherished and loved so dearly. Though I may sometimes stop and sometimes fall, I will never step back. I will give my all to make President Roh’s dream, which is both our past and our future, a reality." The following is the full text of the memorial address: (이 대통령은 이어 “당신께서 그러셨듯, 정치적 유불리보다 옳고 그름을 먼저 묻겠다”며 ”타협보다 양심을, 계산보다 진심을 선택하겠다. 성공한 대통령의 유일한 척도는 국민의 삶이 나아지는 것임을 마음에 새기며, 모든 역량을 쏟아붓겠다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 또 “당신께서 그토록 아끼고 사랑했던 이 나라와 국민을 반드시 지켜내겠다. 때로는 멈춰서고, 때로는 넘어질지라도 결코 뒤로 물러서지 않겠다”며 “우리 모두의 과거이자 미래인 대통령님의 꿈이 현실이 될 수 있도록 혼신의 힘을 다하겠다”고 말했다. 다음은 추도사 전문)

Citizens who have come to Bongha Village,
Respected Madam Kwon Yang-sook, and bereaved family members,
I greet you. I am President Lee Jae-myung. (봉하마을을 찾아주신 국민 여러분,
존경하는 권양숙 여사님, 유족 여러분,
인사드립니다. 대통령 이재명입니다.)

This is the seventeenth May since President Roh Moo-hyun left us. (어느덧 노무현 대통령께서 떠나시고 맞이하는
열일곱 번째 5월입니다.)

Spring in Bongha returns unfailingly every year,
but my heart, coming to this place, changes a little each year. (봉하의 봄은 매년 어김없이 찾아오지만,
이곳을 찾는 저의 마음은 해마다 조금씩 달라집니다.)

At first, I came as one citizen,
then as the leader of the opposition,
and I greeted you as a presidential candidate.
Today, I stand in this place as the President
appointed by you, the people of our nation. (처음에는 한 사람의 시민으로 왔고,
야당 대표로 왔고,
대통령 후보로 인사드렸습니다.
그리고 오늘은 우리 국민 여러분께서 임명해 주신
대통령으로 이 자리에 섰습니다.)

After you left, on this land
countless 'Roh Moo-hyuns' were born again.
I too am one of them. (당신께서 떠나신 후 이 땅에는
수많은 ‘노무현’들이 다시 태어났습니다.
저 역시 그중 한 사람입니다.)

Now, beyond a feeling of remembrance,
feeling the immense responsibility and weight as President of the Republic of Korea,
I intend to carry on your will. (이제 저는 추모하는 마음을 넘어,
대한민국 대통령으로서 막중한 책임과 무게를 느끼며
당신의 뜻을 이어가려 합니다.)

A society where one can succeed without cheating or privileges,
and receive just rewards for the sweat they have shed. (반칙과 특권 없이도 성공할 수 있고
열심히 땀 흘린 만큼 정당한 대가를 얻는 사회.)

A nation where the capital region and the provinces grow and develop together. (수도권과 지역이 함께 성장하고 발전하는 나라.)

A warm community that does not turn its back on others due to differences in background or circumstances,
but understands and embraces one another. (출신과 환경이 다르다는 이유로 등 돌리는 것이 아닌,
서로를 이해하고 품어주는 따뜻한 공동체.)

A world where no one gives up on life over the issue of making a living. (적어도 먹고 사는 문제로 삶을 포기하는 일이 없는 세상.)

A Republic of Korea where people are respected with dignity. (사람이 사람답게 존중받는 대한민국.)

This is the vision of our Republic of Korea
that esteemed President Roh Moo-hyun sought to create throughout his life. (존경하는 노무현 대통령께서 평생에 걸쳐 만들고자 하셨던
우리 대한민국의 모습입니다.)

The unfinished dream of President Roh
will be completed by the Government of the People's Sovereignty. (대통령님의 못다 이룬 꿈,
국민주권정부가 반드시 완수하겠습니다.)

Without fearing the backlash from established interests,
I will firmly push forward reforms that eliminate cheating and privileges. (기득권의 반발을 두려워하지 않고
반칙과 특권을 걷어내는 개혁을 강고하게 추진하겠습니다.)

I will build a balanced, developed Republic of Korea
where people in every corner of the nation,
without any region being left behind, prosper evenly. (어느 곳 하나 소외되는 곳 없이
전국 방방곡곡의 국민이 고르게 잘사는
균형발전 대한민국을 만들겠습니다.)

Carrying on the will of President Roh, who transformed the line of division into a path of peace
and achieved the October 4 Inter-Korean Joint Declaration,
I will walk unwaveringly toward peaceful coexistence and shared growth. (분단의 선을 평화의 길로 바꾸며
10·4 남북공동선언을 이뤄내신 대통령님의 뜻을 이어받아,
평화공존과 공동성장의 길을 흔들림 없이 걸어가겠습니다.)

Just as you did,
I will always ask first about right and wrong, rather than political advantage or disadvantage.
I will choose conscience over compromise, and sincerity over calculation. (당신께서 그러하셨듯,
정치적 유불리보다 옳고 그름을 언제나 먼저 묻겠습니다.
타협보다 양심을, 계산보다 진심을 선택할 것입니다.)

Keeping in mind that the sole measure of a successful president
is the improvement of the people's lives,
I will pour out all my abilities. (성공한 대통령의 유일한 척도는
국민의 삶이 나아지는 것임을 마음에 새기며,
모든 역량을 쏟아부을 것입니다.)

Though much time has passed,
the absence of President Roh is still not familiar.
Yet through this absence,
I feel your presence even more vividly. (세월이 많이 흘렀지만,
대통령님의 부재는 여전히 익숙해지지 않습니다.
그러나 이 부재를 통해
오히려 당신의 존재를 더욱 선명하게 느끼게 됩니다.)

We are living in an era without you, but filled with you—
in the 'age of Roh Moo-hyun.' (당신이 없는, 그러나 당신으로 가득한
‘노무현의 시대’를 우리는 살아가고 있습니다.)

One who said the nickname 'Fool Roh Moo-hyun' pleased him most
and wished to be called that. (‘바보 노무현’이라는 별명이 가장 마음에 든다며
그렇게 불리길 바라셨던 분.)

One who humbled himself greatly, saying he would create a strong nation through modest power. (겸손한 권력이 되어 강한 나라를 만들겠다며
한껏 자신을 낮추시던 분.)

One who smiled, saying if cursing the president helped the people relieve stress, he would gladly endure it. (대통령 욕을 하며 국민들이 스트레스를 해소할 수 있다면
기꺼이 감당하겠다고 웃으시던 분.)

Even after retiring and coming down to Bongha Village,
at the call of the people saying, "Mr. President, please come out,"
he would come out to the yard several times a day
to talk, sing, and spend time with them. (퇴임 이후 봉하마을로 내려오신 뒤에도
“대통령님, 나오세요”라는 국민들의 부름에
하루에도 몇 번이고 마당에 나와
대화를 나누고 노래도 부르고 함께해 주셨던 분.)

Warm to the point of being hot,
more humane than anyone else—the 'person Roh Moo-hyun'—
we all still remember. (따뜻하다 못해 뜨거웠던,
그 누구보다 인간적이었던 ‘사람 노무현’을
우리 모두가 지금도 기억하고 있습니다.)

'The organized power of awakened citizens moves history forward.'
'The power of the people is stronger than power itself.'
'Democracy is safeguarded not by a few leaders,
but by citizens' participation and solidarity.'
That is what he said. (깨어있는 시민의 조직된 힘이 역사를 앞으로 나아가게 한다.
권력보다 국민의 힘이 더 세다.
민주주의는 몇몇 지도자가 아니라,
시민의 참여와 연대로 지켜진다.
이렇게 말씀하셨지요.)

That firm faith left by President Roh
is being continuously proven
by you, the people of our great nation. (대통령님께서 남기신 그 굳건한 믿음을
우리 대한국민 여러분께서
끊임없이 증명해 주고 계십니다.)

Mr. President.
I will surely protect this country and its people,
whom you cherished and loved so dearly. (대통령님.
당신께서 그토록 아끼고 사랑했던
이 나라와 국민을 반드시 지켜내겠습니다.)

Though I may sometimes stop and sometimes stumble,
I will never step back. (때로는 멈춰서고, 때로는 걸려 넘어질지라도
결코 뒤로 물러서지 않겠습니다.)

I will give my all to make that dream of President Roh,
which is both our past and our future, a reality. (우리 모두의 과거이자 미래인 대통령님의 그 꿈이
현실이 될 수 있도록 혼신의 힘을 다하겠습니다.)

Please always watch over us. Thank you. (늘 지켜봐 주십시오. 고맙습니다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Musical actor Jung Min-chan, embroiled in Starbucks ‘certification shot’ controversy, drops out of ‘Diaghilev’ (‘스타벅스 인증샷’ 논란 뮤지컬 배우 정민찬, ‘디아길레프’ 하차)
item.description:
Musical actor Jung Min-chan has withdrawn from the musical he was performing in following a controversy over a Starbucks certification shot. This comes two days after Jung posted a photo of his visit to Starbucks on social media, amid widespread criticism over Starbucks Korea’s promotion using the phrase ‘Tank Day’ on the anniversary of the May 18 Democratic Uprising. (뮤지컬 배우 정민찬이 스타벅스 인증샷 논란 뒤 출연 중이던 뮤지컬에서 하차했다. 스타벅스코리아가 5·18민주화운동 기념일에 ‘탱크데이’ 문구를 넣은 프로모션을 진행해 거센 비판을 받은 가운데, 정씨가 사회관계망서비스(SNS)에 스타벅스 방문 사진을 올린 일이 논란이 된 지 이틀 만이다.)

Showplay, the production company for the musical ‘Diaghilev,’ announced on the 22nd via its official account, “Actor Jung Min-chan, who played the role of Nijinsky, has stepped down from the performance after sufficient discussion with the production company.” The production company added, “We sincerely apologize to the audience for any concern caused by issues related to actor Jung Min-chan, and for any inconvenience and confusion resulting from this sudden decision.” However, the production company did not specify the reason for his departure. (뮤지컬 ‘디아길레프’ 제작사 쇼플레이는 22일 공식 계정을 통해 “니진스키 역의 정민찬 배우가 제작사와의 충분한 논의 끝에 공연에서 하차하게 됐다”고 밝혔다. 제작사는 “정민찬 배우와 관련된 사안으로 심려를 끼쳐드린 점, 갑작스러운 결정으로 불편과 혼란을 드리게 된 점에 대해 관객 여러분께 진심으로 사과드린다”고 했다. 제작사는 다만 하차 이유를 구체적으로 밝히지는 않았다.)

On the 20th, Jung posted a photo of a beverage received at a Starbucks store on his Instagram. He wrote a post to the effect that “A Starbucks employee gave it to me to try, and it tasted like makgeolli. On closer inspection, the color was like coffee mixed with makgeolli.” Some netizens criticized this as an inappropriate post amid the ongoing controversy over Starbucks’ ‘Tank Day’ event. (정씨는 지난 20일 자신의 인스타그램에 스타벅스 매장에서 받은 음료 사진을 올렸다. 그는 “스타벅스 직원이 시음하라고 주길래 마시는데 막걸리 맛이 왜 나는 거지. 가만 보니 색깔도 커피에다 막걸리를 섞은 색깔”이라는 취지의 글을 남겼다. 이를 두고 일부 누리꾼들은 스타벅스의 ‘탱크데이’ 이벤트 논란이 이어지는 상황에서 부적절한 게시물이라고 비판했다.)

As the controversy grew, Jung apologized, saying, “I’m busy living my life and not well aware of news or issues, so I don’t know why I’m getting so much attention, and I’m at a loss. Not knowing and being ignorant is also wrong, so I offer my sincere apologies. I will make sure to keep up with the news in the future.” (논란이 커지자 정씨는 “현생 사느라 뉴스나 이슈거리를 잘 모르는데 제가 뭐라고 이렇게 관심을 다 주시고 몸 둘 바를 모르겠다”며 “몰랐던 것도 무지한 것도 잘못이니 심심한 사과의 말씀을 올린다. 앞으로는 뉴스를 열심히 챙겨 보겠다”고 사과했다.)

Earlier, Starbucks Korea faced controversy for using the phrase ‘Tank Day’ in a tumbler promotion on its official app on the 18th, the anniversary of the May 18 Democratic Uprising. Some promotional phrases were also criticized for evoking the death of activist Park Jong-chul from police torture. As the controversy escalated, Shinsegae Group Chairman Chung Yong-jin apologized, calling it “inappropriate marketing that should never have happened and cannot be tolerated.” (앞서 스타벅스코리아는 5·18민주화운동 기념일인 지난 18일 공식 앱 등에서 텀블러 프로모션을 진행하며 ‘탱크데이’라는 문구를 사용해 논란이 됐다. 일부 홍보 문구는 박종철 열사 고문치사 사건을 연상시킨다는 비판도 받았다. 논란이 커지자 정용진 신세계그룹 회장은 “있어서도 안 되고 용납될 수도 없는 부적절한 마케팅”이라며 사과했다.)

This is not the first time Jung has been at the center of a social controversy. In February, he experienced controversy when his name and photo appeared on a poster for a ‘3.1 Independence Movement Memorial Free Concert’ organized by conservative YouTuber and former Korean history instructor Jeon Han-gil. At the time, Jung stated, “It’s true I received an offer to appear, but I wasn’t given a detailed explanation of the event’s purpose. I also only now learned that the poster was made without any notice. I have no connection to or interest in this event. I am not performing.” At the time, Jeon’s side had released a poster including Jung, singer Tae Jin-ah, and former announcer Lee Jae-yong, but many of them said they were unaware it was a political event and expressed their inability to perform. (정씨가 사회적 논란의 한복판에 선 것은 이번이 처음은 아니다. 그는 지난 2월 한국사 강사 출신 보수 유튜버 전한길씨가 주최한 ‘3·1절 기념 자유음악회’ 출연자 포스터에 이름과 사진이 포함돼 논란을 겪었다. 당시 정씨는 “출연 제의를 받은 것은 맞지만 행사 취지에 대한 구체적인 설명은 듣지 못했다”며 “아무런 말도 없이 포스터를 제작한 것도 이제 알았다. 이번 행사와 아무런 관련도, 관심도 없다. 출연하지 않는다”고 밝혔다. 당시 전씨 쪽은 정씨를 비롯해 가수 태진아, 이재용 전 아나운서 등이 담긴 행사 포스터를 공개했지만, 이들 상당수가 정치 행사인 줄 몰랐다며 출연 불가 뜻을 밝혔다.)

Reporter Kim Yang-jin ky0295@hani.co.kr (김양진 기자 ky0295@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Won-oh Jeong: "During Mayor Oh's Tenure, Gangnam Flooding & Landslide"... Se-hoon Oh: "Jeong Doesn't Even Know the Basics of Redevelopment" (정원오 “오 시장 때, 강남 침수·산사태”…오세훈 “정, 재개발 기초 몰라”)
item.description:
On the first weekend since the official campaign period for the June 3 local elections began, Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party candidate for Seoul mayor, and Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate, each targeted their opponent by citing the missing rebar incident at the GTX Samsung Station and the delay in a redevelopment project in Seongdong-gu. <<> On this day, during a street rally in Eunpyeong-gu, Candidate Jeong mentioned the missing rebar at GTX Samsung Station, stating, "It's been over a week since the media reported it, but (Candidate Oh) hasn't even visited the site yet." He added, "It is the current mayor's responsibility to go to the site immediately, inspect safety, and establish countermeasures." <<> Candidate Jeong also referenced the 1995 Sampoong Department Store collapse. "At that time, poor rebar construction was also a key cause," he said. "What will happen if a major disaster occurs later? Who will take responsibility?" Jeong further mentioned the Itaewon disaster, the Umyeonsan landslide, flooding at Gangnam Station, and the sinkhole casualty in Gangdong-gu, asking, "Why do such large-scale tragedies keep happening during Mayor Oh's tenure?" and vowing, "Let's change the safety-blind Seoul into a safety-first Seoul." <<> Candidate Oh, in turn, blamed Candidate Jeong for the delay in the redevelopment project of Haengdang 7th District in Seongdong-gu, which was under Jeong's watch as district mayor, launching an attack on his "real estate incompetence." During a rally at Sinjeongnegeori in Yangcheon-gu, Oh said, "The completion approval for the Haengdang 7 redevelopment complex has not been granted, leaving 1,000 households unable to register their property." He added, "How can someone who can't even manage redevelopment and reconstruction complexes in their own district claim they'll do better as Seoul mayor? Is that acceptable?" <<> Candidate Oh further stated, "You claim Candidate Jeong does a good job, but does he really? He's irresponsible, incompetent, and a cowardly liar." He added, "Can we entrust the reconstruction of 14 complexes in Mok-dong, Yangcheon-gu, to someone who doesn't even understand the basics of redevelopment and reconstruction?" <<> Earlier that morning, Candidate Oh kicked off his campaign by running from Yeoinaru Station Runner's Station to Hangang Station. He emphasized the Seoul app 'Wrist Doctor 9988,' saying, "I will create a city where people can exercise and turn all Seoul citizens into health millionaires." <<> Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr (6·3 지방선거 공식선거운동이 시작되고 첫 주말인 23일, 서울시장 선거에 나선 정원오 더불어민주당 후보와 오세훈 국민의힘 후보가 각각 수도권광역철도(GTX) 삼성역 철근 누락과 성동구 재개발 사업 지연을 고리로 상대방을 공격했다.)

item.title: Cho Kuk: "Kim Yong-nam's 'Private Loan Company Allegations' Will Negatively Affect Not Just Pyeongtaek-eul but the Entire Democratic Bloc's Election" (조국 “김용남 ‘대부업체 의혹’, 평택을 넘어 민주진영 선거 전체 악영향”)
item.description:
Cho Kuk, the candidate for the Rebuilding Korea Party in the Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul by-election for the National Assembly, stated on the 23rd regarding the allegations that his opponent, Kim Yong-nam of the Democratic Party of Korea, operated a private loan company under a borrowed name, "I believe this will have a negative impact not only on the Pyeongtaek-eul election but on the entire democratic reform bloc's elections." <<> Candidate Cho said this while meeting reporters before attending the 17th anniversary memorial service for the late former President Roh Moo-hyun at Bongha Village in Gimhae on the same day, adding, "I am very worried. This issue should be judged from the perspective of the people." <<> Regarding the possibility of unification with Candidate Kim, Candidate Cho stated, "I believe that at this point, each candidate must have their abilities, qualifications, and track records verified by the people and compete," but also added, "If there is a possibility that Candidate Yoo Ui-dong of the People Power Party, especially the pro-impeachment forces, might unite again and be elected, then at that point, I think we must follow the people's command." <<> On the growing conflict within the conservative support base regarding the alliance or integration between the Democratic Party and the Rebuilding Korea Party, Candidate Cho said, "This is a natural phenomenon (during an election)," and added, "Broadly speaking, since we are a friendly party and comrades, I believe we can overcome it. If we enter the National Assembly through the June 3 election, I will take the lead and take responsibility for the issues of alliance and integration." <<> The previous day, TV Chosun raised allegations that Candidate Kim had operated a private loan company under a borrowed name through an agricultural corporation he owned and received dividends from it. <<> In response, Candidate Kim refuted, saying, "This is entirely not true. The establishment and operation of the relevant company were all carried out lawfully in accordance with legal procedures." <<> In a statement released the previous day, Candidate Kim said, "That agricultural corporation was initially established and operated by the candidate's younger brother, but when it faced a management crisis due to financial issues and various lawsuits, the candidate acquired it around 2020 to help resolve the family's problems. The private loan company mentioned in the report was a corporation that existed before that and was included in the acquisition process. Furthermore, the company had virtually ceased operations, with no new loans for the past two to three years, and has already filed a business closure report with the relevant authorities and is preparing for liquidation procedures." <<> Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr (조국 조국혁신당 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거 후보는 23일 경쟁자인 김용남 더불어민주당 후보가 ‘차명 대부업체 운영’했다는 의혹이 불거진 것에 대해 “평택을 선거뿐 아니라 민주개혁 진영 선거 전체에 나쁜 영향을 줄 것이라고 본다”고 말했다.)

item.title: [Photo] 17th Anniversary of Roh Moo-hyun's Death…Bongha Village Drenched in Yellow Waves ([포토] 노무현 서거 17주기…봉하엔 노란 물결 가득)
item.description:
The 17th anniversary memorial ceremony for former President Roh Moo-hyun was solemnly held on the 23rd at Bongha Village in Jinyeong-eup, Gimhae, South Gyeongsang Province. (노무현 전 대통령 서거 17주기 추도식이 23일 경남 김해시 진영읍 봉하마을에서 엄수됐다.)

The memorial ceremony took place at 2 PM on a special stage in the Bongha Village Ecological Culture Park under the theme "Democracy in My Life, From the Plaza to the Village." The Roh Moo-hyun Foundation stated that this year's theme embodies the hope that democracy, awakened by the shouts of the plaza, will flow into every corner of our villages and blossom. (추도식은 이날 오후 2시 봉하마을 생태문화공원 특설무대에서 ‘내 삶의 민주주의, 광장에서 마을로’를 주제로 열렸다. 노무현재단은 올해 주제에 광장의 함성으로 깨어난 민주주의가 우리의 마을 곳곳으로 흘러들어가 꽃 피우기를 바라는 마음이 담겨 있다고 밝혔다.)

Mourners who came from all over the country visited the burial site to pay their respects and observed the memorial ceremony. The foundation live-streamed the event on YouTube and, for citizens unable to visit Bongha Village that day, also broadcast the ceremony in real-time via large screens and TVs at the Roh Moo-hyun Citizens' Center in Seoul. (전국 각지에서 찾은 추모객들은 묘역을 찾아 참배하고 추모식을 지켜봤다. 재단은 추도식 현장을 유튜브로 생중계하고, 당일 봉하마을을 방문하지 못하는 시민들을 위해 서울 노무현시민센터에서도 대형 스크린, TV를 통해 추도식을 실시간 중계했다.)

President Lee Jae-myung, along with his wife Kim Hye-kyung, attended the memorial ceremony that day, entering with former President Roh's widow Kwon Yang-sook, their son Geon-ho, and former President Moon Jae-in and his wife. Political figures including Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik, Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae, Cho Kuk of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, and Social Democratic Party leader Han Chang-min also attended the ceremony. (이재명 대통령도 김혜경 여사와 이날 추도식에 참석해 노 전 대통령 배우자인 권양숙 여사와 아들건호씨, 문재인 전 대통령 부부와 함께 입장했다. 김민석 국무총리, 우원식 국회의장, 정청래 더불어민주당 대표, 조국 조국혁신당 대표, 한창민 사회민주당 대표 등정치권 인사들도 추도식에 함께 했다.)

In his memorial address, President Lee stated, "A society where success is possible without foul play or privilege, where you receive fair rewards for the effort you put in through hard work, a nation where the capital region and local areas grow and develop together, and a world where you never have to give up on life over basic survival issues—this is the vision of our Republic of Korea that respected former President Roh sought to build throughout his lifetime." He added, "Our people's sovereignty government will surely complete President Roh's unfinished dream." We present a collection of photos from the memorial ceremony sent by the Cheong Wa Dae photo journalists. (이 대통령은 추도사를 통해 “반칙과 특권 없이도 성공할 수 있고 열심히 땀 흘린 만큼 정당한 대가를 얻는 사회, 수도권과 지역이 함께 성장하고 발전하는 나라, 적어도 먹고 사는 문제로 삶을 포기하는 일이 없는 세상은 존경하는 노 대통령께서 평생에 걸쳐 만들고자 하셨던 우리 대한민국 모습”이라며 “대통령님의 못다 이룬 꿈을 국민주권정부가 반드시 완수하겠다”고 밝혔다. 청와대사진기자단이 보내온 추도식 현장의 사진을 모아본다.)

Reporter Lee Jeong-ah leej@hani.co.kr (이정아 기자 leej@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Father who left a legacy of sincerity in politics amid cynicism"...25,000 citizens pay tribute (“냉소 속 진정성의 정치 남긴 아버님”…2만5천 시민 추모)
item.description:
The 17th anniversary memorial ceremony for former President Roh Moo-hyun was solemnly held on the 23rd at Bongha Village, Jinyeong-eup, Gimhae, South Gyeongsang Province. The ceremony, held under the theme "Democracy of My Life, from the Square to the Village," was attended by first lady Kwon Yang-sook, along with bereaved family members, President Lee Jae-myung, former President Moon Jae-in, National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik, and Prime Minister Kim Min-seok. The Roh Moo-hyun Foundation estimated that around 25,000 citizens visited Bongha Village that day. (노무현 전 대통령 서거 17주기 추도식이 23일 경남 김해시 진영읍 봉하마을에서 엄수됐다. ‘내 삶의 민주주의, 광장에서 마을로’란 주제로 치러진 이날 추도식에는 권양숙 여사를 비롯한 유족과 이재명 대통령, 문재인 전 대통령, 우원식 구회의장, 김민석 국무총리 등이 참석했다. 노무현재단은 이날 봉하마을에 2만 5천여명의 시민이 방문한 것으로 추산했다.)

The Roh Moo-hyun Foundation stated, "This year's memorial ceremony embodies the hope that the awakened democracy from the roar of the square will seep into our daily lives and villages, blossoming everywhere." The ceremony proceeded with opening remarks by Foundation Chairman Cha Sung-soo, followed by commemorative addresses from President Lee Jae-myung and former Prime Minister Han Myeong-sook, a tribute performance by the Ggaettong Children's Art Troupe, and remarks by bereaved family representative Noh Geon-ho. (노무현재단은 이날 “올해 추도식은 광장의 함성을 깨어난 민주주의가 우리의 일상과 마을 곳곳으로 스며들어 꽃 피우리글 바라는 뜻을 담았다”고 밝혔다. 추도식은 차성수 노무현재단 이사장의 인사말을 시작으로 이재명 대통령과 한명숙 전 국무총리의 추도사, 개똥이어린이예술단 추모 공연, 노건호 유족 인사말 순으로 이어졌다.)

In his commemorative address, President Lee said, "After you left, countless 'Roh Moo-hyun's' were reborn on this land. I am one of them," adding, "Your unfinished dream will surely be accomplished by the People's Sovereignty Government." President Lee further stated, "We will push forward with reforms that remove unfairness and privilege without fearing backlash from the vested interests. We will build a balanced, developed Republic of Korea where no one is left behind, and all people across the nation prosper equally." This marked the first attendance by a sitting president at the memorial ceremony in nine years since former President Moon Jae-in's participation in 2017. (이 대통령은 추도사에서 “당신께서 떠나신 후 이 땅에는 수많은 ‘노무현’들이 다시 태어났다. 저 역시 그중 한 사람”이라며 “대통령님의 못다 이룬 꿈, 국민주권정부가 반드시 완수하겠다”고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 또 “기득권의 반발을 두려워하지 않고 반칙과 특권을 걷어내는 개혁을 추진하겠다. 어디 하나 소외되는 곳 없이 전국 방방곡곡의 국민이 고르게 잘사는 균형발전 대한민국을 만들겠다”고 덧붙였다. 현직 대통령의 추도식 참석은 2017년 문 전 대통령의 참석 이후 9년 만이다.)

Former Prime Minister Han Myeong-sook said, "During the time of the martial law declaration, we clearly witnessed in the square the 'organized power of awakened citizens' that you so fervently called for and yearned for. In particular, I was deeply moved seeing women braving the cold, snowy winter night, wrapping themselves in a single silver blanket on the pavement, enduring sub-zero temperatures and driving out the darkness of the insurrection with the light of protest glow sticks." She added, "That was possible because the seeds of democracy you planted grew into a rich forest that protected us." (한 전 국무총리는 “계엄이 선포되던 때 우리는 당신이 그토록 부르짖고 갈망하셨던 ‘깨어있는 시민의 조직된 힘’을 광장에서 똑똑히 목격했다. 특히 여성들이 눈이 내리는 추운 겨울밤 길바닥에서 은박 담요 한 장을 뒤집어쓰고 영하의 밤을 견뎌내며 내란의 암흑을 응원봉의 빛으로 몰아내는 모습에 가슴이 뜨거워졌다”며 “당신이 씨앗을 뿌린 민주주의의 싹이 자라 풍성한 숲을 이루어 우리를 지켜주었기 때문”이라고 추도했다.)

The Ggaettong Children's Art Troupe, which performed the tribute, sang "Everyone is a Flower" and "A Good Country." Noh Geon-ho, speaking on behalf of the bereaved family, expressed gratitude to the attendees and said, "Even amidst the vicious cycle of cynicism and hostility, I believe my father's life and politics were valuable because they left a legacy of goodwill and sincerity in politics in the hearts of many." (추모공연을 맡은 개똥이어린이예술단은 ‘모두 다 꽃이야’와 ‘좋은 나라’를 노래했다. 유족을 대표해 인사말을 전한 노건호 유족 대표는 참석자들에게 감사 인사를 전하며 “냉소와 적대의 악순환 가운데에서도 선의와 진정성의 정치를 많은 분들의 마음에 남겼다는 점에서 아버님의 삶과 정치는 값진 것이었다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

After the memorial ceremony, attendees moved to the burial site to pay their respects. The Roh Moo-hyun Foundation stated that around 8,000 people participated in the ceremony that day. (참석자들은 추도식이 끝난 뒤 묘역으로 이동해 참배를 올리며 추모의 마음을 전했다. 노무현재단은 이날 추도식에는 8천여 명이 함께했다고 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, both ruling and opposition parties, which have fully launched their election campaigns, also called for "carrying on the Roh Moo-hyun spirit." Kang Joon-hyun, Senior Deputy Spokesperson of the Democratic Party of Korea, said in a written briefing, "We have upheld the Roh Moo-hyun spirit," adding, "We will shame the complacency of those intoxicated by vested interests and boldly confront any schemes or provocations that deviate from the path of people's sovereignty and the Roh Moo-hyun spirit." (한편 선거운동에 본격 나선 여야도 ‘노무현 정신 계승’을 외쳤다. 강준현 더불어민주당 수석대변인은 이날 서면 브리핑에서 “우리는 노무현 정신을 지켜왔다”며 “기득권에 취한 자들의 안이함을 부끄럽게 하고, 국민 주권과 노무현 정신에서 궤를 벗어난 농간이나 선동에 과감히 맞설 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

Park Seong-hoon, head of the Public Relations Division of the People Power Party's Central Election Committee, also commented, "The spirit of 'unity and coexistence' of the deceased carries a heavy resonance for our society, which is riddled with conflict and hostility." He said, "We must not forget that the way to inherit the 'Roh Moo-hyun spirit' is to practice the collaborative governance he so fervently wished for in the field for the sake of people's livelihoods." Leaders of the People Power Party, including Representative Jang Dong-hyuk, did not attend the memorial ceremony that day. (박성훈 국민의힘 중앙선대위 공보단장도 논평을 통해 “고인의 ‘통합과 상생’의 정신은 갈등과 반목으로 점철된 작금의 우리 사회에 무거운 울림을 던져주고 있다”며 “‘노무현 정신’을 계승하는 길은 고인이 그토록 염원했던 민생을 위한 협치를 현장에서 실천하는 것임을 잊지 말아야 할 것”이라고 밝혔다. 장동혁 대표 등 국민의힘 지도부는 이날 추도식에 참석하지 않았다.)

Reporter Park Da-hae doall@hani.co.kr (박다해 기자 doall@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Park Geun-hye at Chilseong Market: "I should have come sooner... Choo Kyeong-ho will come up with good policies." (칠성시장 뜬 박근혜 “진작 왔어야 하는데…추경호가 좋은 정책 마련할 것”)
item.description:
Former President Park Geun-hye visited a traditional market on the 23rd, the first weekend since the official campaign period for the June 3 local elections began, to support Choo Kyeong-ho, the People Power Party candidate for mayor of Daegu. This marks the first time Park has appeared at an election campaign site since she was impeached from the presidency in 2017. (박근혜 전 대통령이 6·3 지방선거 공식 선거운동 기간이 시작되고 첫 주말인 23일 추경호 국민의힘 대구시장 후보를 지원하기 위해 전통시장을 찾았다. 박 전 대통령이 2017년 대통령직에서 탄핵당한 이후 선거 유세 현장에 모습을 보인 것은 이번이 처음이다.)

On this day, former President Park, along with candidate Choo and National Assembly member Yoo Young-ha, visited Chilseong Market in Buk-gu, Daegu, to greet citizens. As soon as Park stepped out of a black sedan, she received a bouquet from the head of the merchants' association. Entering the market, Park greeted merchants by saying hello or waving her hand. In the Chilseong Market area, supporters of former President Park gathered, waving the South Korean flag and chanting "Park Geun-hye." <<> After touring Chilseong Market for about 30 minutes, Park met with the press and said, "I've heard that many people have said they wanted to see me, to meet with me. Seeing everyone so happy and meeting you all here, I feel sorry and grateful that I should have come to see you sooner." <<> Park then added, "Because I hear the economy is doing poorly, I wanted to offer even a little comfort. It just so happens that candidate Choo Kyeong-ho came along as well, and since he is well aware of the difficult economic situation, I believe he will come up with good policies." <<> When asked by reporters whether she planned to meet Kim Bu-gyeom, the Democratic Party candidate for mayor of Daegu, Park only smiled without answering. Park is scheduled to visit the birthplace of Yuk Young-soo in Okcheon, North Chungcheong Province, on the 25th. <<> By Choi Ha-yan, reporter chy@hani.co.kr ( 박근혜 전 대통령은 이날 추 후보와, 유영하 국회의원과 함께 대구 북구 칠성시장을 찾아 시민들과 인사를 나눴다. 박 전 대통령은 검은색 승용차에서 내리자마자 상인회장으로부터 꽃다발을 건네 받았다. 이후 시장에 들어선 박 전 대통령은 상인들에게 인사말을 건네거나 손을 흔들며 인사했다. 칠성시장 일대에서는 박 전 대통령 지지자 등이 몰려 태극기를 흔들고 ‘박근혜’를 연호했다. )
